Alma and Jun's relaxed demeanor has no bearing on Gus and Zeno's age difference.

Relaxed demeanor before the race doesn't inform anything about the oars' motion once racing begins.
Being relaxed before the race has no direct bearing on the crowd's cheering during the race.
Age difference between Gus and Zeno has no bearing on the start of the race.
